user.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in a desktop browser with developer tools open (F12, Network tab, 'Preserve log' on).
2. Log in. The browser cannot open the result, but the Network tab shows a redirect to `appie://login-exit?code=…`.
3. Paste that whole line, or just the value after `code=`, below. The code is short-lived and works once.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Albert Heijn login has expired. Repeat the steps with [the AH login page]({login_url}) and paste the code.

error.invalid_code: Code rejected (expired or already used). Log in again for a new code.

abort.wrong_account: This is a different AH account than the one configured.

add_regulars.name: Add regular products to shopping list

save_recipe.name: Save recipe
save_recipe.description: Saves (or updates) a recipe. Each recipe gets a persons field and a button.

persons.name: Persons
persons.description: Number of persons the amounts are for

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: One per line, e.g. '400 g mince'. You can paste a recipe from the web.

delete_recipe.name: Delete recipe
delete_recipe.description: Deletes a recipe and its entities.

add_recipe_to_list.name: Recipe to shopping list
add_recipe_to_list.description: Puts the recipe (scaled to persons) on the AH shopping list.

save_receipt_pdf.name: Save receipt as PDF
save_receipt_pdf.description: Saves an in-store receipt as a PDF in a folder (default /media/ha_appie).

save_invoice_pdf.name: Save invoice as PDF
save_invoice_pdf.description: Saves the invoice of a delivered order as a PDF.

get_receipt.name: Get receipt
get_receipt.description: Returns the lines, discounts and payments of a receipt.

product_details.name: Product information
product_details.description: Ingredients, allergens, Nutri-Score and price of an AH product (by product id or barcode).

search_products.name: Search products
search_products.description: Searches AH products and returns them with price, bonus and photo.

add_product.name: Product to shopping list
add_product.description: Puts an AH product on your list; if it is already there the quantity is added.

get_recipe.name: Show Allerhande recipe
get_recipe.description: Returns the ingredients and steps of an Allerhande recipe.

import_recipe.name: Import Allerhande recipe
import_recipe.description: Saves an Allerhande recipe as your own recipe, with the products AH proposes pinned.

add_to_favorites.name: Add to favourites
add_to_favorites.description: Puts a product on a favourite list in the AH app.

init.title: HA Appie options
init.description: Switch parts on or off. Saving reloads the integration. Parts AH does not provide (yet) become unavailable and break nothing.

features.name: Parts
features.description: Everything is on by default, except the bonus card (personal).

data.delivery_details: Delivery details (arrival time, change until, minimum order, invoice)
data.personal_bonus: Personal bonus with prices and status

store_section.name: Store
store_section.description: 0 = your favourite store from the AH app. Or enter an AH store number.

slots_section.name: Free delivery slots
slots_section.description: Optional. The integration never reads your address from AH; enter it here yourself. It is only sent to api.ah.nl to look up free slots.
